families.name: Discovery
families.question: Did this version create or advance mathematics?

families.name: Operations
families.question: What did it cost, how much help did it need, and can the work continue?

decisions.B01: revised: milestones whose only checks are unregistered formal targets are n/a instead of an unreachable ceiling
decisions.B02: kept, moved to rigor: a machine check certifies trust in a result, not its discovery
decisions.B03: revised: refuting a method the run set up only to refute no longer earns 50; literature errors count as obstructions
decisions.B04: retired: contract compliance saturated at 100 while frontier depth stayed low; program freeze stays in provenance
decisions.B05: revised: statement fidelity (no unlabeled added hypotheses or restrictions) is part of claim integrity
decisions.B07: kept: unknown reproduction outcomes no longer count as failures
decisions.B10: retired: orientation and context proxies do not track mathematical value and were unmeasured without telemetry
decisions.B13: added: the strongest new contribution, judged against the closest inspected work
decisions.B14: added: distinct, precisely stated and tested routes or conjectures; creation, not only proof

metrics.name: Frontier depth
metrics.question: How far up the problem's preregistered milestone ladder does the output commit stand?
metrics.formula: 100 * contiguous milestones met / applicable branch length, best of the prove and refute branches. A milestone is met only when every check passes; depth stops at the first unmet milestone. A milestone whose only checks name formal targets the problem does not register is n/a and leaves the branch.
metrics.unknown_policy: A milestone whose checks are pending or unknown stops the depth and marks the score provisional.
metrics.gaming_risk: Easy milestones and inherited progress. Depth is contiguous, depth_start is recorded from the framework commit, and rungs at or above a universal argument require a distinct-thread review or a judgment.

metrics.name: Decisive finding
metrics.question: What is the single most decisive finding off the ladder: counterexample, method refutation, obstruction, literature error or extended exact bound?
metrics.formula: Judged anchor for the best sha-bound, rechecked finding. The computed inventory is evidence only; 0 is computed when the inventory is empty.
metrics.unknown_policy: pending in snapshots unless the inventory is empty.
metrics.gaming_risk: Padding with many weak findings, or refuting a strawman. Only the best counts, counts are not scored, and a self-made strawman is capped at 25.

metrics.name: Novel contribution
metrics.question: What is the strongest new mathematical contribution, and does its novelty survive the closest inspected work?
metrics.formula: Judged anchor for the best item of the computed inventory: registered contribution probes, run claims labeled proved, conjecture or empirical, and workspace documents the run added or changed. Capped at 50 unless every registered closest work is inspected at level T or higher; 0 is computed when the inventory is empty.
metrics.unknown_policy: pending in snapshots unless the inventory is empty.
metrics.gaming_risk: Renaming known or earlier repository results as new, or splitting one result into variants. Only the best counts, novelty is judged against inspected work, and restricted results are scored as restricted.

metrics.name: Idea generation
metrics.question: How many genuinely distinct, precisely stated routes or conjectures did the run generate and test to a verdict?
metrics.formula: Judged anchor over the computed inventory: registered idea probes (for example a failure ledger), run claims labeled conjecture, empirical or refuted, and workspace documents the run added or changed. Credit needs distinct mechanisms, stated objects and falsifiers, and tests that reached a verdict; 0 is computed when the inventory is empty.
metrics.unknown_policy: pending in snapshots unless the inventory is empty.
metrics.gaming_risk: Listing many vague or untested ideas. Ideas without objects and a falsifier earn nothing, parameter variants are one idea, and killed ideas count only with a witness.

metrics.name: Formal assurance
metrics.question: Which maintainer-registered formal targets are machine-checked at the output commit?
metrics.formula: 100 * targets present in a passed verification record, depending only on allowed axioms, with every recorded source hash current / registered targets.
metrics.unknown_policy: n/a when the problem registers no formal target. A judged statement-fidelity failure removes a target from the numerator.
metrics.gaming_risk: A trivial lemma with the target's name. Targets are registered by the maintainer only and statement fidelity can be judged.

metrics.name: Claim integrity
metrics.question: Are material claims labeled correctly, scoped, faithful to the problem's statement, and supported by the cited artifacts?
metrics.formula: Judged anchor from an audit sample with at least one claim per label used, including a statement-fidelity check: a result that adds hypotheses or restricts the problem's statement must say so. Computed flags (label disagreement across records, unreviewed proved claims, hash mismatches, undisclosed agents) are evidence and feed gate review.
metrics.gaming_risk: Hedging every claim to avoid errors. The rubric rewards precise labels, not weak ones.

metrics.name: Adversarial review
metrics.question: Did an independent challenge test the work in every round?
metrics.formula: 100 * passed items / evaluated items over: review per round, verdict recorded, inputs sha-bound, distinct role, distinct thread, independent check run, objections resolved or preserved, reviewer did not co-author the reviewed material.
metrics.unknown_policy: Judged items are pending in snapshots; coverage reports the evaluated share.
metrics.gaming_risk: A friendly critic. Verdicts earn nothing; survival is not rewarded.

metrics.name: Reproducibility
metrics.question: Do the recorded artifacts re-verify from hashed sources?
metrics.formula: Mean of evaluated items: recorded hashes verify, source_stable flags true, recorded checks exited 0, repository checker passes at commit, run directory complete, preregistration order, and in deep mode unit tests and declared reproduction commands.
metrics.unknown_policy: Unevaluated items and reproduction commands without a comparison file are unknown, never failures; coverage reports the evaluated share.
metrics.gaming_risk: Recording few hashes. Coverage is shown beside the score.

metrics.name: Literature grounding
metrics.question: Was the closest prior work inspected and is the novelty label honest?
metrics.formula: Mean of: share of registered closest work recorded at inspection level T or higher in the reading list; share cited in the workspace; novelty label present and judged honest.
metrics.unknown_policy: The honesty item is pending in snapshots.
metrics.gaming_risk: Citing without inspecting. Only reading-list inspection levels count.

metrics.name: Resource efficiency
metrics.question: How much measured compute did the progress cost relative to the problem's reference budget?
metrics.formula: 100 * min(1, reference effective tokens / measured effective tokens), effective = uncached input + cache write + output over lead and child sessions. Overhead sessions are reported separately.
metrics.unknown_policy: unknown without telemetry or a reference budget; n/a when the run made no progress (no new depth and no decisive finding).
metrics.gaming_risk: Cheap empty runs. No progress means n/a, and quality is compared beside cost, never multiplied into it.

metrics.name: Operational autonomy
metrics.question: How much of the planned work ran through the harness without human steering?
metrics.formula: Weighted mean: harness-executed stage share (weight 2), agent-executed stage share (1), failure-free share (1), banded steering and correction turns (1).
metrics.unknown_policy: Human turns are unknown without telemetry; the remaining items still score.
metrics.gaming_risk: Hiding steering in the initial prompt. Approval and status turns are not penalized; classification is heuristic and recorded.

metrics.name: Continuity
metrics.question: Can the next session resume from what this run left behind?
metrics.formula: 100 * passed items / evaluated items over: next step stated, remaining obligations listed, no evidence deleted, status page updated, status record present, and in deep mode a judged cold-start resume test.
metrics.unknown_policy: The cold-start item is unknown outside deep assessment.
metrics.gaming_risk: Boilerplate next steps. The cold-start test checks that a fresh reader reaches the same next action.
